description: NCBI-generated RNA-seq TPM counts for GSE164073 (transcriptional response to SARS-CoV-2 in cornea, limbus and sclera from human donors). Counts come from NCBI's standardized HISAT2 + featureCounts pipeline on GRCh38.p13 (Annotation Release 109.20190905) — reproducible across GEO human RNA-seq series. Full GeneID × GSM matrix is imported by default (~39k genes × 18 samples).

info.pipeline: NCBI GEO RNA-seq counts (HISAT2 + featureCounts, GRCh38.p13)
info.seriesDesign: Cornea, limbus and sclera isolated from human donor tissue; infected with SARS-CoV-2 for 24 hours in triplicate vs mock-infected controls.

name: GEO GSE164073 NCBI TPM (cornea / limbus / sclera ± SARS-CoV-2)
